title: Direction drivers — wind sampling, row set, and terrain
usable_criterion: identical to scripts/label_geometry.py — n_new_cells >= 5 on the ALL-cells row set
dem_nodata_fill: nearest-valid; SRTM carries 0-2.8% nodata and a boxcar spreads each NaN across its window

valley_axis.note: AXIAL: 0-90 deg scale, chance is 45. Not comparable to the 0-180 directional scale the wind and upslope rows use.

bearing_persistence.interpretation: NOT observable at this cadence rather than absent: a continuously curving front sampled every 6-16 h produces large apparent bearing jumps even under perfectly persistent spread.

slope_conditioning.reading: A NEGATIVE correlation means agreement improves as terrain steepens, which is the physical consistency check.
